name: Yulia
source:
She is a woman who visits Sousuke's mansion irregularly, but her details are unknown. Her real name is unknown.

She is a seller who has various connections and offers all kinds of illegal goods to rich people in various places. She is willing to offer her body for successful negotiations. She has no resistance to sexual intercourse and sees it only as a way to enjoy herself and to gain an advantage in negotiations.
